summary: Results‑driven professional with comprehensive experience in human resources, customer service, and financial services. Strong problem‑solving, strategic thinking, and communication skills, known for self‑motivation and teamwork in fast‑paced environments.

experience.title: HR Specialist
responsibilities: Serve as primary contact for escalated HR issues (benefits, recruiting, onboarding, relocation, leaves, workforce administration).
Interpret and articulate customer needs to ensure timely resolution.
Monitor ticketing queues to meet service level agreements and maintain accurate documentation.
Seek guidance on complex issues and follow approval processes.
Support HR analysts and management with special projects.
Maintain quality service and employee satisfaction.
Handle sensitive employee data with discretion.
Prepare and review reports; coordinate mass data uploads.
Maintain SOPs, job aids, and process documents.
Recommend process improvements and enhancements.
Maintain employee records via imaging and indexing.
Assist with invoice reconciliation and administrative duties.

experience.title: Staffing Specialist
responsibilities: Act as on‑site point of contact for Co‑op/Intern program.
Track applicants in Hire systems and manage onboarding (payroll, Identity Manager accounts, badging).
Facilitate new hire orientation and process workflow forms.
Conduct exit interviews and terminate interns from the system.
Conduct new employee orientation to promote organizational objectives.

experience.title: Staffing Coordinator
responsibilities: Respond to benefit questions and resolve payroll/benefits/badging issues.
Coordinate and conduct HR training and workshops.
Maintain knowledge of HR laws and regulations.
Escalate customer issues and prepare benefit refunds, workers’ compensation, jury duty, STD/LTD forms.
Interface with candidates, managers, and associates.
Produce daily staffing reports.
Facilitate new employee orientation and conduct phone screens and interviews.

experience.title: Recruiting Coordinator
responsibilities: Conduct phone interviews and recruit 25 applicants per week.
Develop relationships with colleges, job fairs, and recruitment agencies.
Liaise with business line managers to identify and interview qualified candidates.
Serve as liaison between business lines and HR for recruitment initiatives.
Handle employee communications, pre‑employment screening, and employee information distribution.
Deliver new employee orientation training.

experience.title: Customer Service Representative
responsibilities: Answer inbound calls for 401(k) customers and place outbound follow‑up calls.
Process transactions (loans, withdrawals, exchanges) on 401(k) accounts.
Investigate pending account issues such as address changes and employment status updates.

experience.title: Trustee Board Member
responsibilities: Assist with church decision‑making as appointed by the pastor.
Serve as financial secretary, processing payroll checks.
Analyze and amend the church budget.
Conduct quarterly business meetings and provide financial updates.
